evidence.note: mechanicallyEnforced is assigned typeLevel || runtime || staticAnalysis; any mechanical channel true forces mechanicallyEnforced true, so mechanical-and-not-mechanical is unreachable.
explicitGap is assigned documented || notEnforced; documented true or notEnforced true forces explicitGap true.

gapDoesNotContradictMechanicalEvidence is assigned !notEnforced || !mechanicallyEnforced (NAND). mechanicallyEnforced false forces the gap flag true; notEnforced-and-mechanical with gap true is unreachable.

notes: Expansion of seed hasCoherentEnforcement with omitted derived aliases. Five A.some channel flags remain independently observable from one enforcement array (32 assignments); the three aliases are determined by those flags, so 8-tuples have 32 legal of 256.
